verdict: Leads surged this week; several overdue buildout items now need resolution.
narrative: This period you received 16 leads at an average cost per lead of $99.70 across the 28 days, with a strong surge in the final week — 10 leads in the last four days alone, driven by Meta, pushing your 7-day cost per lead down to roughly $10. That momentum is real and worth building on. What stands in the way of scaling it safely is a set of overdue items — heating campaigns, fall creative, the financing page, and others — that were planned for July through October and remain unresolved; those are being worked through now as the immediate priority. On Google Ads, conversion tracking has a known gap that is being repaired, so the Google lead count under-reports actual results this period. Once the overdue items are cleared and tracking is whole, the conditions are in place for a stronger November heading into heating season.

average cost per lead over the full 28-day window, falling sharply toward period-end

watch_item.issue: Nine planned buildout milestones — including heating campaigns, fall creative, and the financing page — are overdue and blocking a safe scale-up.
